findings.evidence: `grep -rn "matchesMetadata\|GroupPresentation" TauCeti/` matches only GroupPresentation.lean itself; no `example`, no instance, no other file constructs the structure.
findings.fix: Add a concrete small presentation in this PR (e.g. generator names `["a", "b"]` with a relator list) and an `example : P.matchesMetadata` discharging it non-degenerately; or restate `length_relators_eq_expected` to take `P.matchesMetadata` directly.
findings.issue: `matchesMetadata` is a new Prop-valued definition with neither a consuming theorem nor a witness. `length_relators_eq_expected` (line 113) takes the raw conjunct `h : P.transcribed.length = P.expectedRelatorCount`, not `P.matchesMetadata`, and no `GroupPresentation` value exists in the repo, so it is untested whether the dependent record even admits a concrete row (every `Fin` relator index needs `generatorNames.length` to reduce).

findings.evidence: Line 106 `def matchesMetadata (P : GroupPresentation) : Prop := ...`; `grep -rn decide TauCeti/GroupTheory/Presentation/` returns nothing. Roadmap S0 requires the counts be "decidably checkable" (Suggested.lean:495, README.md:478).
findings.fix: Make it `abbrev`/`@[reducible]`, or add `instance (P : GroupPresentation) : Decidable P.matchesMetadata := by unfold matchesMetadata; infer_instance`, and back it with an `example ... := by decide`; otherwise drop "executable" from line 30 and the PR description.
findings.issue: The module docstring calls `matchesMetadata` "the executable generator and relator count check", but it is a semireducible `def ... : Prop` with no `Decidable` instance. Typeclass synthesis runs at `.instances` transparency and will not unfold a plain `def` to expose the `And`, so `by decide` cannot discharge it — the advertised executability does not exist.

summary: The mathematics is faithful: the relation set, presented group, and count lemmas all state what they claim, and the dependent arity genuinely prevents a generator/relator mismatch. But `matchesMetadata` is an unexercised Prop — no consumer, no witness, and no `GroupPresentation` value exists anywhere — and it is advertised as "executable" while not being decidable as written.
